name: abc-conflicts-minority
description: Three lanes contain a true duplicate, complementary findings, two superficially conflicting retry defects at one location, two distinct defects with the exact same generic title and anchor, an unsupported tool failure, and a recall-critical issue reported only by the minority lane.

findings.title: Cache key omits tenant identity
findings.body: The response cache uses only account_id, so equal account ids in different tenants can read each other's cached response.

findings.title: Permanent 404 responses are retried
findings.body: The fallback branch retries permanent 404 responses, wasting the full retry budget on an error that cannot recover.

findings.title: Documented timeout no longer matches the default
findings.body: The guide promises a 30 second timeout, but DEFAULT_TIMEOUT is now 10 seconds.

findings.title: Missing validation
findings.body: update_profile accepts age=-1 because the lower-bound check was removed, allowing an impossible negative age into contribution calculations.

findings.title: Cross-tenant cache collision
findings.body: Because tenant_id is absent from the cache key, account 7 in tenant B can receive tenant A's response for account 7.

findings.title: Transient 503 responses are not retried
findings.body: The same fallback branch returns immediately for 503, so a recoverable service outage bypasses the retry policy.

findings.title: Export error leaks its temporary file
findings.body: When serialization raises, the exception path returns without unlinking the temporary export file.

findings.title: Missing validation
findings.body: update_profile accepts an account_id owned by another user without running the authorization check, enabling unauthorized account updates.

findings.title: Authorization happens after the cache lookup
findings.body: cache_get() runs before authorize(), so a cache hit returns another user's object without ever executing the authorization check.

findings.title: Schema could not be verified
findings.body: schema.sql was unavailable in the provided review workspace and tool access failed, so this review could not inspect it.

expected_issues.title: Documented timeout no longer matches the default
Export error leaks its temporary file
Authorization happens after the cache lookup
